# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| dashboard-json | One Grafana `.json` file generated with `references/dashboard_builder.py` (Step 5) | `deploy-handover`, plant key user | The JSON validates; The datasource UID is a `${DS_NAME}` placeholder; Schema, plugin and Grafana versions are declared in `__requires` |
| panel-sql | Queries inside the JSON | `ops-analytics-asset` | Every query uses the Grafana time macros, is PostgreSQL and DuckDB compatible, and every defined variable is used in each relevant panel |
| audit-record | The Step 6 checklist, run before delivery | Plant key user who imports the file | Every checklist item is ticked or the exception is stated; Portability passed on at least 5 representative panels on both PostgreSQL and DuckDB |
| handover-facts | Fields on the use-case record (per `OD-INTEGRATION.md`) | `deploy-handover` | Output asset, business process, utilization expectation and named plant owner are recorded |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| dashboard-json | manual | plant key user |
| panel-sql | manual | OD lead |
| audit-record | manual | Plant key user who imports the file |
| handover-facts | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `ops-analytics-asset`, `catalog-usecase`, `mi-data-availability`
- **Next:** deploy-handover, then the plant owner.: `deploy-handover`
- **Stops here when:** the schema or archetype is not confirmed, a signal is not standardized or not available, the panel needs several plants at once (not a local dashboard), or a query fails the portability check
- **Stops here when:** Do not show a tracked saving as proven and do not turn an absence into a zero
